title: "E: Unable to locate package ros-humble-..." in ROS 2 apt install: no apt update, missing repo, wrong Ubuntu release, underscores, Gazebo Classic and arm64, measured
excerpt: Why apt can't find ros-humble, ros-jazzy or ros-lyrical packages: empty package lists in Docker images, no ROS repository, Humble on 20.04 or 24.04, underscores, Gazebo Classic on Jazzy and Lyrical, and arm64 gaps. Measured with apt-get on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
